initialize_model_parallel_groups: initialize tensor, pipeline, and data parallel groups for distributed training across multiple GPUs
get_tensor_model_parallel_group: get the tensor model parallel group that the current rank belongs to
get_data_parallel_group: get the data parallel group that the current rank belongs to
get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size: get the world size of the tensor model parallel group for the current rank
destroy_model_parallel: destroy and reset all model parallel groups including tensor, pipeline, and data parallel groups
